title: Testlane profile registry
description: testlane.profiles.json (formerly agent-auth.profiles.json): named sign-in profiles for the Testlane broker. Committed to consuming repos. Holds zero secrets: passwords, PINs and keys live only in the broker's secret store under agent-auth/<profile name> (a stable storage key kept from before the rename). Kept in sync by hand with the zod schema in src/profiles.ts, which is authoritative.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editor validation.

profiles.description: Profiles keyed by name, e.g. "acme:local:admin". The name is also the secret-store key suffix.

propertyNames.description: Profile name. Names starting with "encrypted-file." are reserved for the secret store itself.

environment.description: Environment tag. "production" profiles are always refused by the broker; they exist only so they can be refused by name.

baseUrl.description: Origin (optionally with a path) of the app. http or https only; https is required unless the host is loopback. No credentials, query string or fragment.

strategy.description: Login strategy the broker uses to sign in.

account.description: The account the profile signs in as. Not secret.

email.description: Account identifier shown to the agent. May be empty only on production entries.

role.description: Human-readable role the account is expected to have, e.g. "Sales".

identifier.description: Optional non-secret account identifier, used by dependent-token when fields contain {{identifier}}.

ttlMinutes.description: Session lifetime in minutes. 0 means the profile never issues sessions. The broker issues at most min(ttlMinutes, 480); a requested TTL above that limit is refused, never silently capped. For nextauth-credentials this bounds the artifact the broker hands out but is advisory towards the server (the app's JWT keeps its own maxAge until the Phase-2 handoff route).

allowedHosts.description: Extra hosts this profile may talk to besides baseUrl's host, as lowercase "host" or "host:port". Each entry must parse as a host and is stored in canonical form (for example 127.1 becomes 127.0.0.1). Default ports are omitted when comparing.

options.description: Strategy-specific, non-secret options. Only the keys documented for the profile's strategy are allowed (see allOf below); every *Path option is a path on the baseUrl origin starting with "/", never an absolute or protocol-relative URL.

fields.description: JSON object string mapping field names to string values; values may contain {{email}} and {{secret}} (form fields, or JSON body keys when bodyFormat is "json").

bodyFormat.description: "form" (default): application/x-www-form-urlencoded. "json": application/json object of the substituted string fields.

successBodyField.description: Dot path into the final login response JSON that must hold a non-empty string (presence only; the value is never logged or returned).

dependsOn.description: Profile (same host, non-production) signed in first; its session authenticates the POST to tokenPath. Required to sign in.

tokenPath.description: Path on the profile origin that exchanges this profile's secret for a token or cookie. Required to sign in.

bodyFormat.description: "json" (default): application/json object of the substituted fields. "form": application/x-www-form-urlencoded.

fields.description: JSON object string mapping field names to string values; values may contain {{secret}} (required somewhere), {{email}} and {{identifier}}; no other {{...}} placeholder. Required to sign in.

secretPattern.description: JavaScript regular expression ("u" flag) the secret must match before any request, e.g. "^\d{4,8}$". Used as written, so anchor it. The secret is never echoed on a mismatch.

tokenField.description: Dot path of the token in the JSON response. The token is returned as header tokenHeader. Exactly one of tokenField / sessionCookieName is required to sign in.

tokenHeader.description: Header that carries the token (requires tokenField). Omitted: "Authorization" with a "Bearer " prefix. Set: this exact name with the raw token. Transport and cookie headers (Cookie, Set-Cookie, Host, Content-Length, Content-Type, Origin, Transfer-Encoding, Connection, TE, Upgrade, Keep-Alive, Proxy-Authorization, Proxy-Connection; any case) are refused by the broker.

expiresAtField.description: Dot path of the server's expiry in the JSON response: ISO 8601, unix seconds or unix milliseconds (autodetected). Bounds the artifact's expiresAt.

sessionCookieName.description: Cookie the tokenPath response must set (alternative to tokenField).

mePath.description: Identity endpoint for check / whoami (GET with the artifact's cookies and headers).

emailField.description: Dot path of the email in the mePath JSON (default "email").

roleField.description: Dot path of the role in the mePath JSON (default "role").

options.description: handoff prints the one-time URL; with mePath set (the opt-in), session and check consume it inside the broker and hand out the host-only cookies the route set.

mePath.description: Identity endpoint (GET with the captured cookies). Setting it opts the profile in to session, check and use as a dependsOn; without it they are refused. session refuses unless it reports account.email.

emailField.description: Dot path of the email in the mePath JSON (default "email"; NextAuth's /api/auth/session: "user.email").

roleField.description: Dot path of the role in the mePath JSON (default "role").

profileName.description: A profile name in this or the user registry.

optionPath.description: A path on the profile's baseUrl origin: starts with a single "/", no whitespace, backslash, query or fragment.

dotPath.description: Dot path into a JSON value, e.g. "user.role"; numeric segments index arrays, e.g. "workspaces.0.role".

rotatePath.description: testlane rotate: path on the profile origin of the app's password-change endpoint. Without it rotation is not configured for the profile.

rotateMethod.description: testlane rotate: HTTP method of the password-change request (default POST).

rotateBodyFormat.description: testlane rotate: "json" (default) sends application/json; "form" sends application/x-www-form-urlencoded.

rotateBody.description: testlane rotate: JSON object string mapping field names to string values of the password-change request. Values may contain {{email}}, {{secret}} (the current secret) and {{newSecret}} (required in at least one value); no other {{...}} placeholder is allowed.

rotateVia.description: testlane rotate: profile (same host, non-production) whose session (cookies and headers) authenticates the request, e.g. an admin profile. Default: the profile's own session.

rotateEveryDays.description: testlane status: maximum age in whole days of the stored secret before the "rotation-overdue" alert (default: --max-age-days, else 90). A string, like every option.
